entities.summary: Demetrius (b. 300 BCE) was a renowned Greek explorer and navigator active in the 3rd century BCE, who played a significant role in the expansion of the Hellenistic world. He was a key figure in the Ptolemaic Empire and worked closely with the Macedonian rulers to establish trade routes and colonies along the Mediterranean coast. Demetrius's achievements had a lasting impact on the development of maritime trade and the spread of Greek culture, contributing to the rise of the Hellenistic era. He is remembered as one of the most important figures of his time, and his voyages and expeditions continue to fascinate historians and scholars today.
